title: valid-jsdoc cannot handle FieldType

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
**What version of ESLint are you using?**

2.5.3

**What parser (default, Babel-ESLint, etc.) are you using?**

default (Espree)

**Please show your full configuration:**

Only pasting the relevant part:

``` yaml
valid-jsdoc:
        - 2
        - requireReturn: false
          requireReturnDescription: false
          prefer:
              return: returns
          preferType:
              Any: '*'
              String: string
              Number: number
              Boolean: boolean
              Function: function
              RegExp: regexp
              date: Date
              array: Array
              object: Object
              promise: Promise
```

**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

Tried to validate the following snippet:

``` js
/**
  * @returns {Array.<{date_utc: Moment, comments: number, votes: number}>}
  *          Returns array of objects in the format which the c3js expects:
  * [
  *     {
  *         date_utc: Moment
  *         comments: number
  *         votes: number
  *     },
  *     ...
  * ]
  */
  getRows: function () {
    some.serious.code();
  }
```

**What did you expect to happen?**

The code to pass validation without issues.

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**

ESLint crashed with the following stack trace:
